items.title: 13.5 Halogens ke hydrogen ke saath reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.5, printed pages 295-296.

blocks.text: Halogens hydrogen se react kar ke hydrogen halides dete hain, H2 + X2 se 2HX (X2 = F2, Cl2, Br2, I2); hydrogen halides be-rang gases hain jo pani mein hal ho kar hydrohalic acids banati hain. Hydrogen ke saath reactivity fluorine se iodine tak ghat-ti hai. Fluorine kam darja hararat aur andhere mein bhi hydrogen se dhamake se react karti hai, H2 + F2 se 2HF, jo pani mein hydrofluoric acid ke taur par halti hai. UV roshni ya chingari se chlorine hydrogen se aasani se react kar ke be-rang HCl gas deti hai, jo pani mein hydrochloric acid banati hai. Hydrogen bromide tab banti hai jab bromine garam karne par hydrogen se react kare, ek exothermic reaction; HBr HCl aur HF se kam reactive hai aur pani mein strong hydrobromic acid banati hai. Zyada darja hararat par catalyst ke saath iodine hydrogen se react kar ke hydrogen iodide deti hai, jo pani mein hydroiodic acid banati hai; yeh reaction reversible aur bohat sust hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: har halogen ke hydrogen se react karne ke halaat ki table, fluorine ke liye andhere mein dhamaka-khez se iodine ke liye catalyst ke saath sust aur reversible tak. Oopar daen: H-X bond energies 569, 431, 366 aur 299 kJ mol-1 ka bar chart stability ki tarteeb ke saath. Neeche baen: halide ions ki reducing taqat ki tarteeb wajuhat ke saath. Neeche daen: sodium halides ke ghaliz sulfuric acid se milne par kya hota hai, balanced muadlon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Halogens ke hydrogen se reactions, hydrogen halides ki thermal stability, reducing agents ke taur par halide ions, aur ghaliz sulfuric acid ke saath halides (topics 13.5 se 13.9 aur Table 13.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hydrogen fluorine se andhere mein dhamake se, chlorine se roshni mein aasani se, bromine se garam karne par, aur iodine se catalyst par sirf aahista aur reversible taur par milti hai. Bane hue hydrogen halides apni bond energies ke tanasub se mustahkam hain, jo hydrogen fluoride se hydrogen iodide tak girti hain jaise halogen atom bara hota aur hydrogen se kam achha overlap karta hai, to hydrogen iodide garam karne par sab se aasani se toot-ta hai. Halide ions halogen ka rujhan ulat dete hain: iodide, bara aur kam charge density wala, apna electron sab se aasani se chhorta hai aur sab se taqatwar reducing agent hai, fluoride sab se kamzor. Ghaliz sulfuric acid ke saath fluoride aur chloride bas hydrogen halide chhorte hain, bromide acid ko sulfur dioxide tak reduce bhi karta aur bhoori bromine deta hai, aur iodide use hydrogen sulfide tak reduce karta aur banafshi iodine deta hai.

blocks.prompt: H2 aur F2 ka reaction dhamaka-khez hai magar H2 aur I2 ka sust aur reversible. Wazahat karein (Quick Check 13.3b).
blocks.explanation: Product bond H-F (569 kJ mol-1) toote F-F bond (156 kJ mol-1) se kahin mazboot hai, to reaction bohat energy chhorta hai, kam rukawat rakhta hai aur dhamake se bhaag nikalta hai. Iodine ke liye H-I bond (299 kJ mol-1) I-I (151 kJ mol-1) se sirf thora mazboot hai aur H-H bond bhi torna parta hai, to thori energy nikalti hai; reaction ko garmi aur catalyst chahiye, sust hai, aur kamzor HI aasani se wapas toot-ta hai, use reversible banate hue.

items: H2 + X2 se 2HX, reactivity F2 (andhere mein dhamaka) > Cl2 (UV ya chingari) > Br2 (garmi, exothermic) > I2 (garmi, catalyst, sust aur reversible); HX be-rang gases hain jo hydrohalic acids deti hain.
